# Telicity

> Telicity (telicity.ai) is a company building the operating system and infrastructure for AI, starting with a personal AI assistant and twin that analyzes a person’s intent, turns it into a clear goal, and completes it.

Not to be confused with telicity, the linguistics term, although the company is named after it. In linguistics, telicity is the property of an action that has a built-in endpoint: “run a mile” is telic, “run” is not. The company chose the name because it builds software that carries what a person means through to a finished result.

- Korean name: 텔리시티. Also written as Telicity AI.
- Status: in development.
- Contact: hello@telicity.ai
- The site has the same content in English (https://telicity.ai/) and Korean (https://telicity.ai/ko/).

텔리시티(Telicity)는 AI를 위한 운영체제와 인프라를 만드는 회사입니다. 첫 단계로 사람의 의도를 분석해 분명한 목표로 세우고 끝까지 해내는 개인 AI 비서이자 사용자를 닮아 가는 트윈을 개발하고 있습니다.
